title: Decoupling Action from Egocentric Observation for World Simulation
title_zh: 将动作与第一人称观察解耦以实现世界模拟

paragraphs.en: 总结：本文提出EgoACT测试时框架，通过速度引导结构锚定与稀疏对应校准，实现无需几何估计的第一视角动作迁移，用于世界模拟与机器人数据生成。 Egocentric action transfer aims to decouple the semantic action from egocentric observations and reproduce them in new visual contexts, enabling scalable world simulation, embodied policy learning, and robotic data generation. Existing approaches to transferring actions rely on condition-guided video generation, which converts the observation video into explicit geometric controls (e.g., hand poses or meshes) to drive synthesis. However, these methods introduce geometric estimation errors, making it difficult to preserve physically plausible interactions when transferred to new scenes. Alternatively, motion transfer methods directly extract motion patterns from the observation video, yet motion-level features alone cannot encode rich contact dynamics, frequently leading to severe hand structural collapse and implausible contact layout. To address both limitations, we present EgoACT, a test-time framework for egocentric action transfer that operates directly on the denoising process of video diffusion models without requiring additional geometric estimators. EgoACT uses Velocity-guided Structure Anchoring to stabilize reference-consistent hand-object structure in the early denoising stage, and Sparse Correspondence Calibration to refine reliable local correspondences in the mid-to-late denoising stages. Together, these two components preserve transferable action semantics while improving temporal coherence and interaction realism. We further establish EgoActionBench, a benchmark for evaluating action preservation, visual quality, and hand-object plausibility across diverse egocentric manipulation scenarios. Experiments show that EgoACT generates more coherent and physically plausible interaction videos than strong baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：本文提出EgoACT测试时框架，通过速度引导结构锚定与稀疏对应校准，实现无需几何估计的第一视角动作迁移，用于世界模拟与机器人数据生成。第一视角动作迁移旨在将语义动作从第一视角观测中解耦出来，并在新的视觉情境中复现，从而实现可扩展的世界模拟、具身策略学习与机器人数据生成。 现有的动作迁移方法依赖于条件引导的视频生成，即把观测视频转换为显式的几何控制（如手部姿态或网格）来驱动合成。 然而，这些方法引入了几何估计误差，导致迁移到新场景时难以保持物理上合理的交互。 另一类运动迁移方法则直接从观测视频中提取运动模式，但仅凭运动级特征无法编码丰富的接触动力学，常常导致严重的手部结构坍塌和不合理的接触布局。 为解决上述两类局限，我们提出EgoACT，一个用于第一视角动作迁移的测试时框架，它直接作用于视频扩散模型的去噪过程，无需额外的几何估计器。 EgoACT使用速度引导结构锚定在去噪早期阶段稳定与参考一致的手-物体结构，并使用稀疏对应校准在去噪中后期阶段 refinement 可靠的局部对应关系。 这两个组件协同工作，在保留可迁移动作语义的同时，提升了时间一致性与交互的真实感。 我们进一步建立了EgoActionBench，一个用于在多样化第一视角操作场景中评估动作保持、视觉质量以及手-物体合理性的基准。 实验表明，EgoACT能生成比强基线更连贯、物理上更合理的交互视频。
